channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan hit by nationwide flu outbreak
item.description: The health ministry is asking the public to take basic precautions against infection such as handwashing and covering the mouth when coughing.

item.title: Takaichi told during Trump talks that weak yen was hurting U.S. trade
item.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has repeatedly suggested the BOJ should raise interest rates to help the yen find an appropriate level.

item.title: Tokai Kisen subject of Japan’s first-ever ship suspension order
item.description: Between January and June this year, the ministry conducted an extraordinary inspection of the company and found 13 cases of violations of the law.

item.title: Missed the JLPT? Here’s what you can do next
item.description: Even if you missed out on a spot for this year's Japanese-Language Proficiency Test, you may have more options than you originally thought.

item.title: Fukushima town gets first new supermarket since nuclear accident
item.description: "It will serve as an important base for bringing prosperity and vitality to the community," Okuma Mayor Jun Yoshida said at an opening ceremony.

item.title: Tokyo inflation hits 2.7% in September as some subsidies come to an end
item.description: The reading was above expectations and could increase the chances of a rate rise.

item.title: 23-year-old woman stabbed to death in Okinawa in possible stalking incident
item.description: Rin Zamami was found collapsed and bleeding on the staircase outside of her apartment on Wednesday and was pronounced dead at the scene.

item.title: Sanctioned ICC head’s former students demand action from Tokyo
item.description: A petition with 170,000 signatures has been submitted to Deputy Chief Cabinet Secretary Masanao Ozaki.

item.title: Tepco begins long-delayed probe of Fukushima reactor’s interior
item.description: Tepco has frequently postponed investigations in order to remove accumulated debris and replace cameras, among other reasons.

item.title: Japan to require corporations to report details of beneficial owners
item.description: The government hopes to shed light on the activities of tokuryū criminal groups and gain insight into land ownership by foreign nationals.

item.title: SoftBank stock investors see past credit risks to AI returns
item.description: Masayoshi Son's diverse exposure across the AI landscape —ranging from robotics, data centers and energy — reassures some equity investors.

item.title: Apollo to back $15 billion AI infrastructure project in Japan
item.description: The project, aimed at strengthening AI capacity, is expected to see capital deployed across land, power infrastructure, construction and computing.

item.title: Chinese judoka accused of biting as home hope wins Asian Games gold
item.description: Maeda was awarded victory in the quarterfinal bout in Nagoya when Tang Jing was disqualified just over a minute into the contest.

item.title: Nishikori bows out for final time in Tokyo as crowd salutes Japanese trailblazer
item.description: The 36-year-old was the first Asian man to reach a Grand Slam singles final, at the 2014 U.S. Open.

item.title: Regional banks in northern Japan to consider three-way merger
item.description: The move by three leading banks in neighboring prefectures is likely to send ripples through the industry, adding to a wave of consolidation.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.

item.title: 'I was not going to let others die' - pilot of Flydubai flight describes cockpit attack by co-pilot
item.description: Capt Smit Machchhar tells Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi he opened the cockpit door to let others in during the attack.

item.title: Japan's first mayor to take maternity leave lands on TIME100 Next list
item.description: Shoko Kawata's maternity leave drew mixed reactions in Japan, a country struggling to lift birth rates.

item.title: Japan raises permanent residency fee by 20 times
item.description: The hikes are part of immigration policy changes introduced to manage Japan's growing foreign population.
